title: Pay order-p physical strain cancellation relative to heat
statement: For the LINEARIZED streamwise-independent physical cosine-shear sector with initial Fourier cube cutoff N, transverse components follow heat; the first component has exact kernel2pi integral A(s) H_(T0-s)[sin(2pi y) H_s u2] ds. Each +/-e_y shift kernel has pth time derivative bounded by [nu4pi^2(2N+1)]^p since both heat exponents are nonnegative. The p moment cancellations remove its Taylor polynomial of degree p-1. Multiplying the remainder by actual absolute action, summing the two shifts and using pi<4 yields ||u(T0)-exp(nuT0 Delta)u0||2<=8 Lambda_p theta [64nu(2N+1)T0]^p/p! ||u0||2. This compares with PURE HEAT, and does not cover nonlinear2D3C, arbitrary h, other streamwise/Squire/critical components or a full group-norm bound. Rational background-force residual is separate. For one fixed shear the ENTIRE inviscid physical linear generator is A(t)L; its propagator depends only on integral A. Zero net action therefore gives the identity on EVERY sector, so any echo damping must use viscosity, commutators or multiple shears rather than assumed inviscid end-of-word escape.
